phase timing.source_or_test_rationale: no number found until supplied or measured

asset metadata required: asset ID/version, creator/source/license and approved use
source dimensions, observed runtime quality, alpha/background convention and baked lighting/colors
layout, columns, rows, meaningful-cell count, empty/repeated cells and padding
frame content bounds, pivot/visual center, dominant axis and aspect ratio
semantic tags: material/element, radial/directional, primary/secondary, warning/impact/aftermath
first meaningful frame, contact/peak frame, end frame, built-in windup and dissipation
authored frame cadence and hold pattern, allowed runtime mode, seamless-loop evidence
blend compatibility, tint limits, bright/dark-background preview
camera orientation requirements, intended view angle, practical screen-size test result
compatible companions, redundant baked components and incompatible combinations
low-quality/static fallback, smallest readable version and quality-tier exclusions
asset memory measurement context, device/client/version/graphics quality, visible-overlap test and known bugs
permitted randomization axes, variant family and seed behavior
engine-specific review additions: Communication job first: what it is, what it does, how big its impact is
Importance rating by local player/enemy/ally view, with source and rating rationale
Gameplay truth: authoritative radius/shape, damage or contact instant, warning duration, required visibility window
Primary read and desired feeling/energy; style reference with source date
Layer manifest: asset version, role, origin/axis, transform, color/value, engine class and exact properties
Timeline: windup, punch, crescendo, follow-through, dissipation, sound marker and cleanup; units explicit
Camera and post effects: ownership, intensity/duration curves, reduced-motion/flash policy and cancellation reset
View rules: caster/enemy/ally, distance/projected-size tiers and essential signal retained in each
Repetition policy: allowed variation, seed, measured concurrency cap, retrigger and interruption rules
Performance envelope: baseline device, client version, graphics quality, scene concurrency, CPU/GPU frame time, memory and thermal results
Fallback and pool lifecycle: readiness, reserved critical cue, reset fields, release conditions, no residual light/trail/highlight
Acceptance: truth/readability checks, bright/dark stage, small phone, crowded scene, no-post/low-quality, sound on/off
Claim provenance: each number tagged spec/default/example/calculation/measured project result; unsupported value remains no number found
release status: template only; no production values selected
